scope: All ten cited cases independently read; exact evidence, speaker/deployment, lexical unit, work independence, variants, and disposition checked under IRIYA_ADJUDICATION_GUIDE.md.

cohortFindings.semanticAdmission: PASS 10/10. Each retained phrase is independently deployed as an answer, verdict, test, raised saying, case appraisal, or controlled interview formula.
cohortFindings.lexicalUnits: PASS 10/10. All are single phrase-level components; none is merely a compositional action string or an improperly fused couplet.
cohortFindings.distinctWorks: PASS 10/10. Independent searches found distinct workIds and materially separate deployments for every row. The multi-source rulings do not depend solely on split volumes or duplicate editions.
cohortFindings.exactEvidence: REVISE. Five stored KWICs pass zc.verify and five fail because their manually bounded text is not an exact corpus substring.
cohortFindings.variantHandling: PASS with one enrichment note. 一状領過 correctly resolves the unattested simplified head form to corpus 一狀領過 (246 hits / 115 works). 亘古亘今 is itself attested (234 / 61), while the additional corpus spelling 亙古亙今 is also substantial (198 / 95) and should be recorded as a search variant when the evidence is recut.

reviews.finding: Qixia Cheng applies it as the verdict on Budai's attempted display; a distinct work applies it to the elder's arrangement in another case. The stored KWIC verifies exactly and the phrase is a reusable case appraisal.
